assumed_values.name: fs_hz
assumed_values.rationale: Paper prints T=200 ms, not fs. 1000 Hz matches Kozunov/OSF MEG. Gives n_times=200. Alternative 256 Hz (ERP CORE) was not used.

assumed_values.name: n_times
assumed_values.rationale: 200 ms * 1000 Hz = 200 samples.

assumed_values.name: I_c
assumed_values.rationale: Unspecified. Modest value 40. MEG has 80 epochs/subcategory; bioRxiv overlay '100 trials' is ambiguous (MC vs I_c). Not tuned.

assumed_values.name: Upsilon_d
assumed_values.rationale: Paper adds unspecified C×C noise to D0. Small symmetric Gaussian.
assumed_values.value: symmetric additive Gaussian on unique i<j entries; sigma = 0.05 * std(D0_upper, ddof=1); clip to >=0; diag=0

assumed_values.name: butterworth_implementation
assumed_values.rationale: Paper: 6th-order Butterworth 2 Hz LPF on rows of Z. filtfilt vs causal not stated.

assumed_values.name: one_over_f_generator
assumed_values.rationale: PSIICOS used 5th-order zero-phase bandpass (theta/alpha/beta/gamma) with 1/f band weights on a 20000-vertex grid and longer epochs. That grid is not public; a 200 ms window cannot host well-resolved theta IIR bands. FFT 1/f is the narrowest '1/f noise' reconstruction on the AD 5002 mesh.
assumed_values.value: FFT pink noise, S(f)∝1/f, DC=0, unit RMS per source, random vertices, constrained orientation

assumed_values.name: forward_model
assumed_values.rationale: Only public candidate on OSF 8rk67. Never fsaverage. D13.
assumed_values.status: approximate / blocked by missing source asset
assumed_values.value: OSF 8rk67 subject-AD tess_cortex_pial_low (5002 vtx) + headmodel_surf_os_meg overlapping-spheres Gain (322 x 15006, 3 ori). Paper does not name this mesh.

assumed_values.name: sensors
assumed_values.rationale: Gain is 322×15006; rows 306:322 are NaN (non-MEG). First 306 are finite MEG. Row RMS repeats large, large, small => GRAD, GRAD, MAG. Mixing MAG+GRAD without whitening would ignore magnetometers. Paper MEG analysis used 204 planars. Channel.mat is not on OSF.
assumed_values.value: 204 planar gradiometers (Gain rows 0:306, drop every 3rd of GRAD-GRAD-MAG triplets)

assumed_values.name: source_orientation
assumed_values.rationale: Paper says N×1 topography g_m. Constrained normals are the Brainstorm default for this headmodel.

assumed_values.name: SNR_definition
assumed_values.rationale: Paper: ratio of root mean powers of noiseless sensor matrix to noise matrix.
assumed_values.status: paper Eq. 15–16 discussion (root mean powers); stacking/trial grouping assumed
assumed_values.value: gamma such that RMS(noiseless stacked conditions) / RMS(gamma * noise) = SNR, per trial

assumed_values.name: MNE_regularization
assumed_values.rationale: Paper names MNE, not lambda. SNR=3 matches the public constrained sLORETA kernel field, not a simulation statement.
assumed_values.value: lambda^2 = trace(G G.T) / (n_channels * SNR^2) with SNR=3.0

assumed_values.name: LCMV_regularization
assumed_values.rationale: Paper names LCMV, not the covariance estimator or loading.
assumed_values.value: ridge = 0.05 * mean eigenvalue of sample covariance of concatenated demeaned trials

assumed_values.name: RSA_ST_trial_pairing
assumed_values.rationale: Fig. 1b: inverse per trial, then average squared distances. Pairing rule not printed.
assumed_values.value: pair trials by index l=1..I_c (equal I_c across conditions)

assumed_values.name: ReDisCA_cosine_abs
assumed_values.rationale: Printed cosine is signed; Haufe/GEP pattern sign is free. Absolute cosine is required for localization.

assumed_values.name: fig6_snr
assumed_values.rationale: Fig. 6 SNR is not stated. Reuse Fig. 5 body SNR=0.2 (four-source, more challenging).

assumed_values.name: fig5_C
assumed_values.rationale: Caption C=6, body C=5. Subset language in §2.4.3.
assumed_values.value: generate C=6; evaluate C=6 and C=5 (first 5 conditions) — D14

assumed_values.name: fig6_C_construction
assumed_values.rationale: Section 2.4.3.
assumed_values.value: subset of the C=6 condition set (first C conditions), not independent M of size C×C

assumed_values.name: mixing_M
assumed_values.rationale: S = M Z with Z in R^{C×T}.
assumed_values.value: C×C i.i.d. N(0,1); one M (single-source) or four M_p (multi-source); held fixed across MC

assumed_values.name: canonical_ReDisCA
assumed_values.rationale: demean_time=True is a labeled extra on Fig. 4 only.

assumed_values.name: rng
assumed_values.rationale: Paper does not give seeds. Secondary seed is a 20-MC ReDisCA-only check, not a tuning loop.
